view_frame: Front view (XZ plane) showing the vase silhouette. X is width, Z is height. The part is axisymmetric about the Z axis. The drawing shows the full profile from the axis of rotation (left) to the outer surface (right).

features.evidence: Single continuous outline showing a vase shape with a flared rim, narrow neck, bulbous body, and flat base. The left edge is the axis of symmetry.

connections: The profile is a single closed loop representing a hollow vessel with uniform wall and floor thickness.
edit_rules: Changing the max_radius scales the body width.
Changing the height scales the vertical dimension.
Changing wall_thickness or floor_thickness adjusts the inner profile offset.
The profile must remain closed and watertight.
